episode_contract.unit: one unique risk-approved action identity at its actual action clock
episode_contract.equivalent_playbook_evidence: stored as contributing hypothesis keys and fixed causal features
episode_contract.entry_plan_freeze: entry, original structural invalidation, primary target and deadline freeze at risk approval
episode_contract.fill_or_expiry: next-bar causal execution; unfilled or expired approval resolves to 0R gross action value
management: protect only to a later confirmed structural level without widening original risk
model or risk exit on a later bar
episode_contract.gross_label: realized frozen-policy gross_R for a filled-and-closed action, 0R for next-bar unfilled or expired action
episode_contract.right_censoring: pending entries and positions open at the registered boundary are excluded from fitting and reported separately
episode_contract.cost_decomposition: 2023 has no causal MBO cost label; the fitted component is managed gross action value. Runtime managed net value subtracts the current causal MBO round-trip cost_R and the preregistered fillability shift penalty.

fit.standardization: fit on each training fold only
fit.support: all standardized continuous features within the full-fit training min/max expanded by no more than 0.25 standard deviations; all evidence indicators registered
fit.uncertainty: training residual RMSE; runtime uses mean minus one residual RMSE before observed execution deductions

time_out_of_sample_gates.failure_behavior: artifact status unavailable; enter cannot outrank abstain

runtime_net_utility.minimum_advantage: unchanged from the frozen decision configuration; no threshold search before objective alignment
runtime_net_utility.data_quality: unknown, stale, constant-assumption or anomalous execution remains a hard risk veto

leave_one_playbook_out.June_July_MBO_role: post-fit falsification only; may not select model features, ridge lambda, support or action threshold
